purpose: diagnostic only; no solver/DB value is modified by this file

solver.tree: no limp; open 2bb (SB 2.5bb) or jam 30; opener vs 3bet = call/fold only (max_raises=2)

ante.limitation: BB live stack is not reduced by the full 1BB BBA; treat as near/limited, especially for BB defense.

reference_status.search: all 14 remote branches searched (filenames + data/* content for stack 30); 30bb hits are only our own solver pilot (and its re-ingest in data/gto_db/spots), HU/subgame solver configs, 8-max Matthiola, and aggregate-only public crosschecks. Harvest DISCOVERY_AUDIT_20261003 also lists "30 BB full tree" as an open gap.

definitions.open: raise + jam (raw actions preserved in solver_raw)
definitions.ref_class: clear_open: J20 and J40 >= 0.95; clear_fold: both <= 0.05; else boundary
definitions.midpoint_residual: solver_open - (J20+J40)/2; linear-interpolation diagnostic, not a truth gap
definitions.missing_mass_pp: combo-weighted sum of negative bracket_gap, in % of 1326 combos
definitions.SB: solver has no limp; Jens 20bb SB limps. SB open compared as raise-vs-raise, limp reported separately
